groups.defect: ProvideAnonDBStore now takes a bare int64 deviceLimit, but pkg/server/wire.go still registers it as a provider and binds AnonStore to it, so wire generation or the build fails.
groups.rationale: All three point at the same lines and describe the same stale wire registration. They propose the same fix: remove the provider and Bind, or take *setting.Cfg.

groups.defect: tagDeviceUI sets the local cache entry before CreateOrUpdateDevice runs and does not remove it on ErrDeviceLimitReached. Rejected devices therefore hit the cache for 29 minutes, and the device limit is bypassed.
groups.rationale: All three report the same issue: the cache is written before the DB write and the entry is not removed on failure. They propose the same fix in tagDeviceUI.
